say:1:1130310001:1.text: It's not time for supper, but I'm a bit hungry already.
say:1:1130310001:1.source_cn: 那倒没有，还没到饭点，但我已经有点饿了。
say:1:1130310001:1.male: It's not time for supper, but I'm a bit hungry already.
say:1:1130310001:1.female: It's not time for supper, but I'm a bit hungry already.

say:2:1130310002:1.text: Luckily I have some wild sandbeast meat to hold me over until then.
say:2:1130310002:1.source_cn: 还好我这里有些野猪肉，只能先烤了吃来解解馋。
say:2:1130310002:1.male: Luckily I have some wild sandbeast meat to hold me over until then.
say:2:1130310002:1.female: Luckily I have some wild sandbeast meat to hold me over until then.

say:3:1130310003:1.text: Doesn't look half bad, does it? Everyone says I'm a great grill master!
say:3:1130310003:1.source_cn: 看起来还不错吧？大家都说我烤肉的手艺很好！
say:3:1130310003:1.male: Doesn't look half bad, does it? Everyone says I'm a great grill master!
say:3:1130310003:1.female: Doesn't look half bad, does it? Everyone says I'm a great grill master!
